title: Constitution 365 Source Routing Map
purpose: Routes each Constitution 365 lesson to the authoritative source layers required for generation and validation.

constitutional.role: Primary source for the Constitution of India itself.

legal.role: Supplementary source for ordinary legislation and statutory frameworks.
legal.restriction: A statute must never be presented as if it were a provision of the Constitution.

judicial.role: Supplementary source for judicial interpretation and constitutional doctrine.
required_for: High Court decisions where specifically required
judicial.restriction: Judicial interpretation must never be presented as constitutional text.

historical.role: Supplementary source for constitutional history and historical context.

official.role: Supplementary source for current institutional and administrative information.

routing_logic.constitutional_only: Use constitutional-sources.json when the lesson can be completely supported by constitutional text.
routing_logic.constitutional_plus_legal: Use constitutional-sources.json as the constitutional foundation and legal-sources.json for statutory context.
routing_logic.constitutional_plus_judicial: Use constitutional-sources.json as the constitutional foundation and judicial-sources.json for judicial interpretation.
routing_logic.constitutional_plus_historical: Use constitutional-sources.json as the constitutional foundation and historical-sources.json for historical context.
routing_logic.constitutional_plus_official: Use constitutional-sources.json as the constitutional foundation and official-sources.json for institutional information.
routing_logic.mixed: Load every explicitly required source layer and preserve the distinction between constitutional, statutory, judicial, historical and institutional material.

unresolved.policy: A day must not be generated as fully verified if its required source mapping is unresolved.
unresolved.generic_source_policy: Generic placeholders in legal or other source files must not be silently converted into guessed source IDs.
unresolved.missing_source_policy: If a required source file or source entry does not exist, generation must stop for that day.
unresolved.judicial_source_policy: A judicial lesson must not receive invented case names, citations, holdings, dates, or quotations.
unresolved.current_law_policy: Where current statutory or institutional information is required, the generator must verify that the source represents the applicable current position.

rules: Every generated day must have at least one authoritative source.
The Constitution must remain the primary source whenever the lesson concerns constitutional text.
Additional sources may supplement the constitutional source but must not replace it.
Every source ID referenced by a day must exist in its corresponding source file.
Every unresolved source must be reported before generation.
A day with an unresolved mandatory source must be blocked from AI generation.
The generator must preserve the distinction between constitutional text, statutory law, judicial interpretation, historical context, and official institutional information.
